blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate on Thursday approved on third and final reading a bill that would resstrict social media use by children below 18 years old. In a 16-1-0 vote, the upper chamber approved Senate Bill No. 2424, or the Child Online Safety and Protection Act. Sen. Risa Hontiveros was the lone legislator who voted against the measure. Sponsored by Sen. Robinhood Padilla, the measure seeks to protect children from physical, mental, social, and emotional harms from the use of social media platforms.
